name: FallASleep - Device sleep timer
tagline: Lock the screen after a timer runs out.
blurb: Setup a timer between one and 60 minutes.
description:
Setup a timer between one and 60 minutes. Once the timer runs out, the app will lock your device's screen.

Features:
• Simple and clean design

• Lock screen after 1 to 60 minutes

• Remembers last timer

• Quick setting tile

• Notification to stop, extend or reset timer

Permissions:
• Device admin to lock the screen
